question: Can Tāriṇī be accomplished by vast ages of practice alone?
premises: crores of hundred-million ages are mentioned
Tāriṇī is the goddess in question
inference: Even vast ages of practice do not bring success in Tāriṇī without the proper means.
uncertainties: the proper means are implied from prior verses
plain_english: Even by crores of hundred-million ages, O goddess, Tāriṇī does not succeed.
